title: MVVM Architecture

core.purpose: Cross-cutting infrastructure with no business logic.

modules.constants: Stable numeric/string/route identifiers (AppColors, AppSizes, AppRadius, AppStrings, AppRoutes).
modules.theme: Material 3 light/dark theme and shared text styles.
modules.models: Generic value objects used by multiple features (Result, AsyncValue helpers).
modules.network: Placeholder for future REST clients; not used today.

widgets.glass: Glass UI Core Widget Library — premium glass-morphism surface used across the application. See glass section below.
widgets.scaffold: LiquidScaffold — global screen surface used by every feature. See liquidScaffold section below.

glass_ui_library.purpose: Production-ready, reusable glass component library that becomes the visual foundation of the application.
design_principles: Strict separation between foundation and feature widgets.
Every widget folder is self-contained with its own constants, models (when needed), extensions (when needed) and barrel exports.
No hardcoded colors, typography, spacing, radius or animation durations — every value flows from the project's design system (AppColors, AppSizes, AppRadius, AppTheme).
Responsive sizing auto-bumps tiers on tablet/desktop using BuildContext.media queries.
Light and dark themes supported automatically via the active ColorScheme.
Performance: const constructors, no per-frame BackdropFilter on hidden surfaces, shallow widget trees, single overlay per dropdown.
Animations: flutter_animate entrance effects + targeted AnimationController for stateful feedback. No bouncy or flashy transitions.
Strictly presentation-only: no business logic, no provider injection beyond local UI state, no Firebase, no Firestore.
Composable: every widget accepts child + styling overrides, has sensible defaults, and never assumes the surrounding design.

widgets.GlassContainer: Foundation surface. Owns blur, gradient, tint, border, shadow, rounded clipping, animated appearance, ink interaction, light/dark adaptive styling. Used by every other glass widget.
widgets.GlassCard: Reusable content card with title/subtitle/leading/trailing/body/footer slots, optional tap, hover lift, selected and disabled states. Built on GlassContainer.
widgets.GlassSummaryCard: Dashboard analytics surface with large animated value, label, subtitle, icon badge, progress, status badge, trend indicator and optional chart slot. Built on GlassContainer.
widgets.GlassPrimaryButton: Premium call-to-action button with filled-glass style, loading, disabled, leading/trailing icons, gradient, animated press feedback, ripple, adaptive sizing, full-width and compact modes.
widgets.GlassDropdownContainer: Reusable blur popup surface used by every dropdown. Scrollable, animated, adaptive height, custom item widgets, selection support, empty and loading states.
widgets.GlassDropdownButton: Searchable, validated dropdown selector with leading/trailing icons, hint, loading/error/disabled states, animated open/close and a custom overlay popup.

folder_structure.lib/core/widgets/glass/exports.dart: Top-level barrel re-exporting every widget for single-import access.

dependency_flow: core/widgets/glass widgets never depend on features/, data/, or domain/
glass_ui_library.widget_builder_integration: Every glass widget is registered in GlassPreviewRegistrar (lib/core/widgets/glass/preview_page.dart). The GlassPreviewPage is exposed as the route '/glass-preview' for design review and is intended to be linked from the Widget Builder catalog.

liquid_scaffold.purpose: Global screen surface and the foundational layout engine of every feature screen. Wraps a Material Scaffold (preserving SnackBars / dialogs / focus traversal), layers background → body → overlay → loading via a Stack, and exposes title / subtitle / errorState / emptyState / drawer / ambient-background shortcuts so a new screen is one widget away from the full Alor Poth Liquid Glass aesthetic.
design_principles: Screens never instantiate Material Scaffold directly; they consume LiquidScaffold so background, padding, SafeArea, scroll, entrance, overlay, loading, ambient lighting, theming, error / empty state and Material chrome live in one place.
Two glass-depth slots: background (painted first, below body) and overlay (painted last, above body). They never wrap the body itself — the body is the page content.

Tokens only: every colour, blur, opacity, radius, padding, motion, ambient animation duration, loading disc size, overlay scrim alpha and image-blur sigma is read from LiquidTheme, LiquidScaffoldThemeData, AppSizes, AppAnims, AppButtonSizes or the scaffold's own constants file.

Theme-first: LiquidScaffoldTheme extends ThemeExtension so scaffold-level tokens theme with the rest of the app. LiquidScaffold mounts a default instance automatically when none is present, so a screen works standalone but is themed consistently when wrapped.

Ambient background: opt-in via AmbientBackgroundStyle (enabled:false by default). When enabled, LiquidBackground paints 2–3 soft blurred light blobs and drives them with a slow internal AnimationController wrapped in a RepaintBoundary.

Body composition: LiquidBody owns SafeArea → padding (explicit or responsive via LiquidScaffoldResponsivePadding) → optional SingleChildScrollView with ClampingScrollPhysics → optional fadeUpEntrance.
Loading chrome: LiquidLoading — hairline-glass disc with a themed spinner; uses the same LiquidGlassEffect + ButtonPalette tokens as the button family.
Title shortcut: when appBar is null and title is non-null, LiquidScaffold auto-builds a CustomAppBar with AppBarVariant.defaultBar. errorState / emptyState win over body when supplied.
Strict rules: no business logic, no Firebase, no Firestore. No raw Scaffold in feature code. No hardcoded colour, blur, radius, padding or duration anywhere inside the scaffold module.

modules.LiquidScaffold: Public host widget. Wraps Material Scaffold with a Stack of background → body → overlay → loading. Resolves appBar (auto-builds from title when null) and body (errorState / emptyState priority over body). Bootstraps LiquidScaffoldTheme when none is present.
modules.LiquidScaffoldConstants: Const-friendly defaults for the LiquidScaffold constructor (booleans, BoxFit, AmbientBackgroundStyle default).
modules.LiquidScaffoldThemeData: ThemeExtension that owns every scaffold-level token: padding, responsive padding tiers, ambient blob count / blur / radius / opacity / animation duration, loading disc size / spinner stroke / spinner diameter, overlay scrim opacity, image blur sigma. Static `light` and `dark` instances.
modules.LiquidScaffoldTheme: InheritedWidget exposing LiquidScaffoldThemeData down the tree. Static of(context) / maybeOf(context) accessors.
modules.LiquidScaffoldContextX: BuildContext extension providing `context.liquidScaffoldTheme` and `context.hasLiquidScaffoldTheme` so consumers never touch the InheritedWidget directly.
modules.LiquidBackground: Self-contained background layer. Solid theme base + optional gradient + optional blurred image + optional ambient blobs. Owns the AnimationController for ambient lighting. When `background` is supplied, replaces every other layer.
modules.AmbientBackgroundStyle: Immutable configuration object. enabled / tint / blobCount / maxBlurSigma / maxRadiusFraction / opacityMin / opacityMax / duration.
modules.LiquidLightBlobsPainter: CustomPainter that renders List<LiquidBlobSpec> as soft radial-gradient circles. shouldRepaint compares every blob's spec.
modules.LiquidBlobSpec: Immutable per-blob spec: center, radius, opacity. == + hashCode by all three fields.
modules.LiquidSafeArea: Edge-aware SafeArea with `color: Color?` defaulting to Colors.transparent so the scaffold never paints an opaque Material slab over LiquidBackground.
modules.LiquidBody: Body composer. LiquidSafeArea → Padding (explicit / responsive / default) → SingleChildScrollView (optional, ClampingScrollPhysics) → fadeUpEntrance (optional).
modules.LiquidOverlay: Positioned.fill wrapper for the overlay slot. Optional scrim with overlay-scrim-opacity from LiquidScaffoldThemeData.
modules.LiquidLoading: Centred hairline-glass loading disc with a themed CircularProgressIndicator. Uses LiquidThemes + LiquidScaffoldThemeData for every value.
modules.LiquidOverlayConstants: Loading disc / spinner size defaults (mirror AppButtonSizes), loading fade duration, scrim opacity default.

dependency_flow: liquid_scaffold_exports re-exports every sibling module so screens never import internals
core/widgets/scaffold/** → core/liquidGlass/theme, core/liquidGlass/effects, core/constants, core/animations, core/extensions, core/widgets/button, core/widgets/appbar
core/widgets/scaffold widgets never depend on features/, data/, or domain/
liquid_scaffold.consumption_pattern: Every feature screen calls LiquidScaffold(...) instead of Scaffold(...). Minimum API surface: body (or errorState / emptyState). Optional: title / subtitle (auto-AppBar), appBar, padding, responsivePadding, scrollable, entranceAnimation, background / backgroundGradient / backgroundImage / backgroundBlur, ambient, overlay, loading, drawer / endDrawer, and all Material chrome (FAB, bottomNavigationBar, bottomSheet, persistentFooterButtons, primary, extendBody, extendBodyBehindAppBar, resizeToAvoidBottomInset). Splash uses backgroundGradient; Onboarding wraps body in LayoutBuilder + IntrinsicHeight for Spacer semantics; HomeDashboard uses appBar + padding. ambient:const AmbientBackgroundStyle(enabled: true) opts into animated blurred light blobs.

modules.widgets: Widgets that bridge two or more features (e.g. LoadingView).

features.purpose: Self-contained verticals. Each feature owns its full MVVM tree.

presentation.screens: Page-level widgets. Read-only observers of their ViewModel.
presentation.widgets: Feature-specific reusable widgets. Should compose core/widgets/glass widgets for any visual surface.
presentation.viewmodels: AsyncNotifier / Notifier exposing UI state and commands. Depend on UseCases only.

domain.entities: Pure Dart models (no Flutter, no Firebase).
domain.repositories: Abstract contracts that the data layer implements.
domain.usecases: Single-responsibility classes encapsulating one business operation.

data.models: Firestore / API DTOs and their mappers.

datasources.remote: Firebase, REST API clients. Return DTOs only.

data.repositories: Implementations of the domain contracts. Map DTOs → entities.

dependency_flow: presentation/viewmodels → domain/repositories (only when no use case fits)
rules: Widgets never import Firebase, Firestore, or any data-layer symbol.
ViewModels never import Widgets or Flutter UI primitives.
UseCases never import Widgets or Flutter UI primitives.
Repositories never import Widgets or Firebase UI SDKs.
Data sources never return entities; they return DTOs.
Repositories never call datasources synchronously without error handling.
All Riverpod providers are declared in the layer they expose; cross-layer providers live in core/di/.
Glass widgets never depend on features/. They live strictly under core/widgets/glass/.
Glass widgets never hardcode design values — every constant comes from the project's design system.
Glass widgets are presentation-only: no business logic, no domain/data imports.
Screens never instantiate Material Scaffold directly; they consume CustomScaffold so background, padding, SafeArea, scroll, entrance, overlay and loading concerns are centralised.
CustomScaffold widgets never depend on features/, data/, or domain/. They live strictly under core/widgets/scaffold/custom_scaffold/.
CustomScaffold widgets never hardcode design values — every constant comes from the project's design system or its own constants file.
